scenes.say: [knowing, slightly amused] Walk me through it. [beat] Here's what that means.
[casual] They flipped through your deck. Market overview. Customer research. Financials. Next steps. [dry] Four slides... no story.
[beat] [emphatic] It means: your titles should tell it.

titles: Faster setup pays back in *a year*
scenes.say: [confident] Small firms grow fastest. They leave because setup takes weeks. Faster setup pays back in a year. [pointed] So we fix it first.

scenes.caption: Made in Occam
scenes.say: [confident] In Occam, the first slide tells the whole story.

scenes.loop: Read *only* your titles. Is it a story?
scenes.say: [upbeat] One sentence per title. In order, a story. No walk-through needed. [playful] Now read only your titles... is it a story?
